uc1.title: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics
uc1.alt: Use case 1 — Temporal dynamics: annual growth of light
uc1.caption: Between 2014 and 2025, night-time light in Malawi changed by +5.0% per year (95% CI: +2.6% to +6.8%). Over the last 12 months, the seasonally adjusted level is -2.6% relative to the previous 12 months. (confidence high: significant trend (p < 0.01; n = 12))
uc1.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc3.title: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP
uc3.alt: Use case 3 — Lights and GDP: light–GDP elasticity
uc3.caption: The elasticity of light with respect to real GDP is 1.43 in levels (95% CI: 0.75 to 2.11, R² = 0.69, 12 years) and 0.56 in growth rates (CI: −3.44 to 4.56). Out of sample, light growth tracks GDP growth with a correlation of −0.22 (mean absolute error: 2.2 percentage points of growth). (confidence medium: n = 12, significant but wide CI (1.36))

uc4.title: Use case 4 — Economic shocks
uc4.alt: Use case 4 — Economic shocks: shock trough
uc4.caption: The most pronounced shock in the seasonally adjusted series is “COVID-19”: trough of +2.6% (09/2020), return to the pre-shock level after 7 months. (confidence low: trough compared with pre-shock month-to-month variability)
uc4.source: VIIRS DNB monthly (VCMSLCFG) · NOAA/EOG · Google Earth Engine

uc5.title: Use case 5 — Inequality & access
uc5.alt: Use case 5 — Inequality & access: of residents in the dark
uc5.caption: The Gini coefficient of light per capita (ADM2) is 0.42 in 2025 (no significant change since 2014). About 0.52 million people live in inhabited areas with no detectable light (66% of the inhabited population). (confidence medium: sensitive to the radiance threshold (from 0.48 to 0.57 M depending on the threshold); a proxy for outdoor lighting, not for grid connection)

uc6.title: Use case 6 — Industrial zones
uc6.alt: Use case 6 — Industrial zones: industrial clusters
uc6.caption: 20 industrial clusters detected from concordant satellite signals: 11 heavy industry, 6 business parks & logistics, 1 oil & gas sites and 2 isolated sites to verify. They emit 14.0% of national light (latest year); their light changes by +2.2% per year. Southern Region has the most industrial activity. (confidence low: precision 55% and recall 27% against the reference list)
